gotchas.title: Tanya's W-2 uploaded twice (PDF + phone photo)
gotchas.trap: Autoflow picks up both documents -> $47,000 wages and $2,810 withholding counted twice.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Mark photo upload as DUP (same EIN, control no., amounts). One W-2 for Brightsmile Dental.

gotchas.procedure_section: General Return Prep Notes - blank organizer line with PY amount
gotchas.title: Ally Bank 1099-INT not in initial PBC
gotchas.trap: Organizer line blank; preparer assumes zero and omits $1,246 of interest (recurring, $980 in 2024).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Open item emailed to client 02/24; 1099-INT received 03/04 and included on line 2b.

gotchas.title: Newborn not on organizer
gotchas.trap: Organizer lists 2 dependents; baby born 12/18/2025 only disclosed in a later email.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Add Noah as dependent (child born during the year is treated as living with the taxpayer all year; SSN issued before due date). Third $2,200 CTC.

gotchas.procedure_section: OBBBA - no tax on overtime (Schedule 1-A Part III)
gotchas.title: W-2 box 14 shows TOTAL overtime pay
gotchas.trap: Deduct the full $9,450 box 14 overtime amount.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Only the FLSA premium ('half' of time-and-a-half) qualifies. Box 14 = total OT paid at 1.5x -> premium = 9,450 / 3 = $3,150.

gotchas.procedure_section: OBBBA - car loan interest (Schedule 1-A Part IV)
gotchas.title: Two vehicle loans, only one qualifies
gotchas.correct_treatment: F-150: new, 2025 purchase, US final assembly, personal use, VIN reported -> $2,452 deductible. CR-V: used vehicle, 2024 loan -> not qualified.

gotchas.title: Dependent care FSA and overnight camp
gotchas.trap: Claim credit on $6,000 of expenses ignoring the $5,000 W-2 box 10 exclusion and including overnight camp.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Exclude $5,000 FSA (box 10) first; credit base = $6,000 cap - $5,000 = $1,000; overnight camp ($1,400) is not a qualified expense. Credit 20% x $1,000 = $200.

gotchas.title: HSA code W includes employee pre-tax payroll deferrals
gotchas.trap: Take an additional HSA deduction on Schedule 1 line 13 for the $2,000 Marcus 'contributed'.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Code W = employer + cafeteria-plan contributions, already excluded from wages. No Sch 1 deduction. 1099-SA used for qualified medical - nontaxable; Form 8889 still required.

gotchas.title: Roth 401(k) (code AA) is not pre-tax
gotchas.correct_treatment: Code AA is already included in box 1. No adjustment.

software_exceptions.title: Duplicate W-2 (PDF + phone photo) picked up by Scan/AutoFlow
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Axcess Scan/AutoFlow created three W-2 input records - Marcus (Lone Star Distribution) plus Tanya's Brightsmile Dental W-2 twice (client PDF and phone photo, same EIN and control no. BSD-22-014). The return calculates on both copies: wages and withholding overstated by Tanya's W-2 amounts (about $47,000 of wages).
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Income/Deductions > Wages, Salaries, Tips (W-2): delete the duplicate W-2 record created from the phone photo; bookmark the photo DUP in the binder so it does not AutoFlow again. Line 1a = $105,478; line 25a = $6,770.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: ProConnect has no binder-based AutoFlow in the firm's workflow; W-2s are keyed (or imported - import options per current release - verify). The same overstatement occurs if both copies are entered.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Wages, Salaries, Tips > W-2 screen: one record per W-2 (two total). Tie line 1a to the W-2 box 1 tape (105,478) before finalizing.
software_exceptions.proconnect_reference: Screen name per current release - verify
software_exceptions.notes: Control number and EIN match is the tell; the photo is a re-upload, not a second job.

software_exceptions.title: Schedule 1-A Part III overtime: W-2 box 14 shows TOTAL overtime pay, not the premium
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: The qualified-overtime input takes whatever is keyed. If box 14 'OVERTIME 9,450.00' is keyed (or mapped) as qualified overtime compensation, Axcess deducts $9,450 on Schedule 1-A - it cannot know the box 14 figure is total overtime pay at 1.5x rather than the FLSA premium.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: W-2 worksheet / Schedule 1-A qualified overtime input (verify field path in current release): enter $3,150 (9,450 / 1.5 x 0.5 = 9,450 / 3). Keep the calculator tape on WP 3. MAGI $106,763 < $300,000 MFJ - no phase-out.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - ProConnect deducts the qualified overtime amount entered; it has no way to split total OT pay.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Enter $3,150 in the qualified overtime compensation field for Marcus (Schedule 1-A input - screen/field per current release - verify).
software_exceptions.procedure_section: OBBBA - no tax on overtime (Schedule 1-A Part III)
software_exceptions.notes: 2025 transition: employers were not required to report qualified overtime separately; a reasonable method (premium = 1/3 of time-and-a-half pay) is allowed. From 2026 use W-2 box 12 code TT if reported.

software_exceptions.title: Schedule 1-A Part IV car-loan interest: only the new F-150 loan qualifies
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Both lender year-end interest statements (Ford Credit F-150, Honda CR-V) were keyed as qualified passenger vehicle loan interest; Axcess deducts $3,557. The software cannot test 'new vehicle', 'loan originated after 12/31/2024' or 'final assembly in the U.S.' - those are preparer determinations.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Schedule 1-A qualified vehicle loan interest input (verify field path in current release): keep only the Ford Credit loan - interest $2,452, VIN entered (required on Schedule 1-A). Delete the Honda record (used vehicle, 2024 loan - personal interest, nondeductible).
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - the deduction is computed from the loans entered.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Schedule 1-A vehicle loan interest input: one record (F-150, VIN, $2,452). Screen/field per current release - verify.
software_exceptions.efile_impact: None (VIN must be reported on Schedule 1-A)
software_exceptions.procedure_section: OBBBA - car loan interest (Schedule 1-A Part IV)
